enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Swift
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: To block this enemy, you need twice as much Block as its Attack value.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Brutal
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: If unblocked, it deals twice as much damage as its Attack value.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Poison
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: If a Unit gets Wounded because of an attack from an enemy with Poison, it is given two Wound cards instead of one. For each Wound a Hero takes into their hand from a Poisonous attack, they also put one Wound into their discard pile.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Paralyze
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: If a Unit gets Wounded because of an attack from an enemy with Paralyze, it is immediately destroyed. If a Hero takes Wounds into their hand from a Paralyzing attack, they must discard all non-Wound cards from hand.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Assassination
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: Damage from this attack cannot be assigned to Units.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Summon
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: At the start of the Block phase, draw a random enemy token of the specified color. It replaces the summoner in the Block and Assign Damage phases.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Fire Attack
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: Only Ice and Cold Fire Blocks are efficient when blocking this attack.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Ice Attack
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: Only Fire and Cold Fire Blocks are efficient when blocking this attack.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Cold Fire Attack
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: Only Cold Fire Blocks are efficient when blocking this attack.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Cumbersome
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: In the Block phase, you may spend Move points to reduce this enemy's Attack value.

enemy_offensive_abilities.name: Vampiric
enemy_offensive_abilities.description: Armor is increased by 1 for each Unit wounded and each Wound added to a Hero's hand by this enemy.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Fortified
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: Only Siege Attacks can be used against this enemy in the Ranged and Siege Attacks phase.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Elusive
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: Use the lower Armor value only if all enemy attacks are successfully blocked.

enemy_defensive_abilities.name: Defend
enemy_defensive_abilities.description: Enemies with Defend must be targeted before enemies without Defend.
